tree_elements.content:
name: Runtime X11 v1 Integration

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - integration/runtime-x11-v1-20260917
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'runtime/core_v1/**'
      - 'runtime/guarded_x11_v1/**'
      - 'runtime/backends/x11_v1/**'
      - 'runtime/cli_v1/**'
      - 'research/live_control/native_handle_bridge_v1.py'
      - 'research/live_control/test_native_handle_bridge_v1.py'
      - 'research/live_control/agent_review.py'
      - 'research/live_control/test_agent_review.py'
      - 'research/live_control/receipt_image.py'
      - 'research/live_control/receipt_references.py'
      - 'research/live_control/test_receipt_references.py'
      - 'research/live_control/native_review_recovery_v1.py'
      - 'research/live_control/native_exchange_v1.py'
      - 'research/live_control/test_native_exchange_v1.py'
      - 'research/live_control/native_cleanup_v1.py'
      - 'research/live_control/test_native_cleanup_v1.py'
      - 'research/live_control/native_visual_watch_v1.py'
      - 'research/live_control/test_native_visual_watch_v1.py'
      - 'research/live_control/native_release_observation_v1.py'
      - 'research/live_control/test_native_release_observation_v1.py'
      - 'research/live_control/agent_exchange.py'
      - 'research/live_control/run_native_calc_self_use_v1.py'
      - 'research/live_control/test_native_finish_after_v1.py'
      - '.github/workflows/runtime-x11-v1.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  x11-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          sparse-checkout: |
            runtime/core_v1
            runtime/guarded_x11_v1
            runtime/backends/x11_v1
            runtime/cli_v1
            runtime/selector_v1
            runtime/motor_state_v1
            research/live_control/agent_review.py
            research/live_control/test_agent_review.py
            research/live_control/receipt_image.py
            research/live_control/receipt_references.py
            research/live_control/test_receipt_references.py
            research/live_control/native_review_recovery_v1.py
            research/live_control/native_exchange_v1.py
            research/live_control/test_native_exchange_v1.py
            research/live_control/native_cleanup_v1.py
            research/live_control/test_native_cleanup_v1.py
            research/live_control/native_visual_watch_v1.py
            research/live_control/test_native_visual_watch_v1.py
            research/live_control/native_release_observation_v1.py
            research/live_control/test_native_release_observation_v1.py
            research/live_control/native_handle_bridge_v1.py
            research/live_control/test_native_handle_bridge_v1.py
            research/live_control/native_tail_v1.py
            research/live_control/run_native_calc_self_use_v1.py
            research/live_control/test_native_finish_after_v1.py
            research/live_control/scoped_target_handle_v1.py
            research/live_control/scoped_target_handle_v2.py
            research/live_control/scoped_target_handle_v3.py
            research/live_control/coordinate_frame_transform_v1.py
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'
      - name: Install X11 test dependency
        run: |
          python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check python-xlib==0.33 Pillow==10.2.0 numpy==1.26.4
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y -qq xvfb x11-xkb-utils
      - name: Compile runtime core and X11 backend
        run: python -m compileall -q runtime/core_v1 runtime/backends/x11_v1
      - name: Test experimental handle bridge boundary
        env:
          PYTHONPATH: research/live_control
        run: python -m unittest -v test_native_handle_bridge_v1 test_agent_review test_native_exchange_v1 test_receipt_references test_native_visual_watch_v1 test_native_release_observation_v1 test_native_cleanup_v1 test_native_finish_after_v1
      - name: Run private Xvfb integration
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          AUTH="$RUNNER_TEMP/x11v1.auth"
          : > "$AUTH"
          Xvfb :88 -screen 0 1024x768x24 -ac >"$RUNNER_TEMP/xvfb.log" 2>&1 &
          XVFB_PID=$!
          trap 'kill "$XVFB_PID" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
          sleep 0.5
          DISPLAY=:88 XAUTHORITY="$AUTH" python -m unittest -v runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_integration runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_mapping_boundary runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_text_plan runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_partial_execution runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_scroll_ledger runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_explicit_up_ledger runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_sidebutton_ledger runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_capture_artifacts runtime.cli_v1.test_native_golden_boundary

"""Run the native integration contract suites locally or in CI, without GUI/model calls."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SUITES = {
    'protocol': ['runtime.integration_checks.test_delivered_capture', 'runtime.integration_checks.test_workload', 'runtime.integration_checks.test_host_timing', 'runtime.cli_v1.test_observe', 'runtime.selector_v1.test_selector',
                 'runtime.cli_v1.test_mcp_relay', 'runtime.cli_v1.test_mcp_server', 'runtime.cli_v1.test_mcp_clock', 'runtime.cli_v1.test_mcp_session', 'runtime.cli_v1.test_mcp_guarded', 'runtime.cli_v1.test_guarded_presentation', 'runtime.cli_v1.test_public_presentation', 'runtime.cli_v1.test_public_summary', 'runtime.cli_v1.test_post_dispatch_capture', 'runtime.cli_v1.test_cli', 'runtime.core_v1.test_contract', 'runtime.core_v1.test_compiled_gui', 'test_compiled_compatibility_v1', 'runtime.cli_v1.test_review', 'test_agent_review', 'test_receipt_references', 'test_native_exchange_v1', 'test_native_mcp_v1',
                 'test_native_allocation_v1', 'test_native_mcp_relay_v1', 'test_native_direct_task_v1',
                 'test_native_primary_review_v1', 'test_native_brief_review_v1', 'test_native_guarded_form_v1', 'test_guarded_source_dependencies_v1', 'test_appserver_journal_close_01a0ff2d', 'test_appserver_reader_retirement_01a0ff2d'],
    'harness': ['runtime.guarded_x11_v1.test_input_dependency', 'runtime.guarded_x11_v1.test_compiled', 'runtime.guarded_x11_v1.test_move', 'runtime.guarded_x11_v1.test_reference_lifetime', 'runtime.guarded_x11_v1.test_activation', 'runtime.guarded_x11_v1.test_deadline', 'runtime.guarded_x11_v1.test_history', 'runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_focus', 'runtime.cli_v1.test_x11_target_review', 'runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_mapping_boundary', 'runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_text_plan', 'runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_partial_execution', 'runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_scroll_ledger', 'runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_explicit_up_ledger', 'runtime.backends.x11_v1.test_sidebutton_ledger', 'test_native_finish_after_v1', 'test_native_cleanup_v1',
                'test_native_handle_bridge_v1', 'test_native_tail_v1', 'runtime.distribution_v2.test_distribution', 'runtime.guarded_x11_v1.test_archive', 'runtime.distribution_v2.test_compiled_archive'],
}

SUITES['protocol'].append('test_app_server_eof_stop')

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--protocol-python', default=sys.executable)
    parser.add_argument('--harness-python', default=sys.executable)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True, help='fresh directory for full logs and result.json')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    out = args.output.resolve()
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',
               PYTHONPATH=os.pathsep.join([str(ROOT), str(ROOT/'research/live_control')]))
    results = []
    for name, modules in SUITES.items():
        python = args.protocol_python if name == 'protocol' else args.harness_python
        command = [python, '-m', 'unittest', '-v', *modules]
        started = time.monotonic_ns()
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=ROOT, env=env, capture_output=True)
            code, stdout, stderr = result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr
        except OSError as error:
            code, stdout, stderr = 127, b'', (str(error)+'\n').encode()
        ended = time.monotonic_ns()
        logs = {}
        for stream, data in [('stdout', stdout), ('stderr', stderr)]:
            path = out/f'{name}.{stream}.log'
            path.write_bytes(data)
            logs[stream] = {'file': path.name, 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}
            print(data.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'), end='', flush=True)
        results.append({'suite': name, 'command': command, 'returncode': code,
                        'duration_ns': ended-started, 'logs': logs})
    passed = all(r['returncode'] == 0 for r in results)
    report = {'schema': 'agent-interface/local-native-check-v1',
              'status': 'PASS' if passed else 'FAIL', 'suites': results,
              'scope': 'contract tests; not a live GUI experiment or independent adoption audit',
              'runner_sha256': hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    (out/'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n', encoding='utf-8')
    print(json.dumps({'status': report['status'], 'report': str(out/'result.json')}))
    return 0 if passed else 1

if __name__ == '__main__':
    raise SystemExit(main())
